question: AI Prediction result on people with different races
content:
Analysis of Predictive Policing Algorithm v4.2:
- Black Subjects: 45% Flag Rate (+20% vs actual)
- Yellow Subjects: 15% Flag Rate (+5% vs actual)
- White Subjects: 8% Flag Rate (-9% vs actual)

Conclusion: Model exhibits severe racial bias.
suggestion: More data collection and analysis factor needed for variety of racial groups.
